hilfe.titel: Help on “{titel}” in the administrator manual
hilfe.label: {hilfe} for this step in the manual (opens in a new tab)
gesperrt.code: The setup code has been checked. It only applies until Ablago is set up.
gesperrt.datenbank: The database is connected. The connection can only be changed in the container’s configuration (administrator manual → Installation).
gesperrt.fertig: Only after “Set up now” in the summary.
gesperrt.lauf: Ablago is being set up. Whatever doesn’t work you change directly in the list.
gesperrt.abschluss: Ablago is set up. From now on you make changes in the Workbench.
wahl.neu: An empty Ablago: you put together the library, your account and packages, check everything in a summary and then set it up.
ablage.unter: What is your Ablago called? Usually the name of the family or the company.
ablage.name: Name of your library
ablage.hinweis: It appears as the lettering in the header, in the browser tab and on the sign-in page. You can change it at any time under Workbench → Themes → Logo and lettering.
konto.unter: You sign in with this account – with your own email address. It gets “Full administration”: you may set up and administer Ablago and also work in the library with it.
konto.verweis: In the configuration file, the password is the reference {verweis}. Ablago only evaluates it during a setup without an interface; in the browser you set the password here.
konto.name: Name
konto.alltag: Day to day you work without administration rights. To set things up you switch via “Administer Ablago”. That way nothing important breaks by accident.
konto.zweifaktor: Ablago offers you two-factor sign-in at the end of setup – with “Set up now” or “Later”. It isn’t required.
konto.erst: Your account is only created with “Set up now” at the end. Until then you can change everything. You invite more people afterwards under Workbench → Users.
pakete.erst: Installing only happens with “Set up now” at the end. Until then you can change the selection at any time.
pakete.unter: Packages bring ready-made folder types, views and functions such as text recognition. Choose what you need right away – you get everything else later under Workbench → Packages.
pakete.offline: Without internet you get the packages after setup under Workbench → Packages – there also with a bundle file. Skip the step or try again.
pakete.katalog: The package catalogue can’t be reached, the packages from the file can’t be checked. {fehler}
pakete.unbekannt: These packages don’t exist in the catalogue: {namen}.
pakete.bestaetigen: The packages from the file need your confirmation (permissions, origin, names or settings). Check the selection and confirm it.
optional.unter: Everything here can also be set later in the Workbench. “Continue” applies what is in the fields – empty fields stay empty.
optional.adresse.text: Users open Ablago at this address; it is used in the links in emails.
optional.adresse.hinweis: Prefilled with the address you are using to open Ablago right now. Clear the field if Ablago shouldn’t have a fixed address.
optional.adresse.leer: Without an address, the links use the address Ablago is currently opened with.
optional.region.text: For public holidays: no daily summary of tasks is sent on public holidays. You set country and time zone under Workbench → Region.
optional.beispiele.text: A few ready-made folder types (e.g. contracts, invoices) as a starting point. They can be adapted or deleted.
optional.beispiele.pakete: Only without packages that bring their own folder types – otherwise folder types would exist twice.
optional.mail.text: For invitations, password links and the daily summary. Usually your address and password are enough; the assistant suggests the rest. Sending is only set up with “Set up now”. Without email sending, Ablago shows the links for copying.
optional.mail.passwort: The password never goes into the configuration file.
optional.mail.verweis: In the configuration file, the password is the reference {verweis}. In the browser you enter it here.
optional.mail.testen: You can test sending after setup under Workbench → Email and address.
optional.notfall.text: Who should be asked in an emergency? These people get no access – only a short info email without a link, once email is set up. They appear on the emergency sheet under “Whom to ask?”.
plan.ablage.fehlt: Please enter a name for the library, e.g. “The Smith family”.
plan.ablage.lang: The name may have at most {max} characters.
plan.passwort.fehlt: Please set a password for your account. Passwords are never in the configuration file.
plan.mail.server: The server for email sending is missing.
plan.mail.passwort: The password for the mail server is gone after reloading. Please enter it again.
zf.unter: This will be set up. Nothing has been created yet – change what doesn’t fit, and then set up Ablago with one click.
zf.offen: Not viewed yet: {schritte}. Please go through these steps first.
zf.pakete.vorgabe: from the file, still to be confirmed
zf.adresse.keine: none – links use the address in use
zf.schluessel: During setup Ablago creates a new key for passwords and backups. Afterwards you download the emergency sheet – only then is setup complete.
zf.datei.text: Saves this setup as a configuration file (YAML), for example for a second Ablago or for reference. Passwords and the key aren’t included – Ablago asks for them when loading or creates a new one.
zf.datei.fertig: Saved. The file is in your downloads folder.
zf.erst: Ablago can only be set up once all sections are fine.
lauf.unter: This usually only takes a few seconds, a bit longer with packages. Please keep the page open.
lauf.unter.fehler: What has already been done is kept. Change the detail or try again – nothing is created twice.
lauf.rest: The steps below wait until this one has worked.
lauf.passwort.neu: The password for your account is gone after reloading. Please enter it again under “Change”.
lauf.schluessel.zustand: There is a key that doesn’t match this Ablago. Check under Workbench → Encryption before you continue.
lauf.mail.passwort: The password for the mail server is gone after reloading. Please enter it again under “Change”.
lauf.pakete.einstellungen: The packages’ settings are gone after reloading (they are only kept in memory). Please enter them again under “Change”.
lauf.pakete.teil: Not installed: {namen}. You catch up on this under Workbench → Packages.
abschluss.unter: One last step: the emergency sheet. Afterwards you continue in the Workbench in administration mode; with “End administration” you work in the library.
abschluss.unterbrochen: Setup was interrupted, and this browser no longer knows what had been collected. You catch up on what’s missing in the Workbench – the overview reminds you.
abschluss.notfallblatt.text: Ablago has created a new key. The emergency sheet contains it – without it no backup can be restored if the NAS fails. Download it, print it and keep it safe.
abschluss.geladen: Emergency sheet downloaded. Print it and keep it safe.
abschluss.pflicht: “Finish setup” only works once the emergency sheet has been downloaded.
abschluss.zweifaktor.text: In addition to the password, Ablago then asks for a code from an app on your phone when you sign in. Anyone who only knows your password can’t get in. Voluntary – you can also set it up later under My account → Security.
abschluss.zweifaktor.spaeter.text: All right – you’ll find it at any time under My account → Security.
abschluss.zweifaktor.fertig: Two-factor sign-in set up. From now on Ablago also asks for the code when you sign in.
abschluss.link.fuenf.text: what you should do now so that everything runs safely.
abschluss.link.problem.text: as a prepared GitHub issue with version and environment.
abschluss.fehlt: Please download the emergency sheet first – without it no backup can be restored if the NAS fails.
datenbank.datei: Prefilled from the configuration file. The password is never in it – please enter it here.
datei.laden.titel: Load a saved setup (YAML or JSON): Ablago fills in all steps and shows the summary.
datei.zugross: The file is too large for a configuration file (at most 64 KB).
datei.nachcode: “{name}” chosen – Ablago checks the file as soon as the setup code is correct.
datei.ersetzen.titel: Use the details from the file?
datei.ersetzen.text: What you have already entered will be replaced by the details from the file.
datei.fehler.titel: The configuration file can’t be loaded. Nothing has changed.
datei.fehler.version: Unknown format version – this Ablago reads “ablago-einrichtung: {version}”.
datei.fehler.passwort: Passwords don’t belong in the file. Leave the field out (then the assistant asks) or refer to an environment variable, e.g. ${DMS_KONTO_PASSWORT}.
datei.fehler.adresse: The address must start with http:// or https://.
datei.fehler.unbekannt: Unknown field. A typo, or from a newer version of Ablago?
datei.fehler.gross: The file is too large (at most {kb} KB).
datei.hinweis.datenbank: The file names the database {datei}, Ablago is connected to {jetzt}. The connected database stays.
datei.hinweis.benutzer: The file still names a first user ({wer}). The assistant no longer creates them – invite more people after setup under Workbench → Users.
datei.kommentar.kopf: Setup of Ablago – for loading in the setup assistant (“Load from configuration file”).
datei.kommentar.geheim: Without passwords and without the key: the assistant asks for passwords, Ablago always creates a new key.
datei.kommentar.datenbank: Connection to PostgreSQL (only applies as long as Ablago has no database yet).
datei.kommentar.ablage: Name of the library – lettering in the header and browser tab.
datei.kommentar.konto: Your account: sets up Ablago, may administer it and also works in the library.
datei.kommentar.pakete: From the official catalogue, each the newest matching version; automations: true = switched on.
datei.kommentar.optionales: Address for links, federal state for public holidays, examples, email sending (without password).
lauf.neugeladen: Interrupted because the page was reloaded. Please try again – nothing is created twice.
assistent.die-datenbank-ist-verbunden: The database is connected. Ablago is now creating its tables – this takes a moment.
assistent.waehle-eine-sicherung-aus: Choose a backup from the backup folder. Afterwards you sign in with the credentials that applied at the time of the backup – a new account isn’t needed.
assistent.die-datenbank-ist-verbunden-2: The database is connected and still empty.
assistent.neues-nas-alte-sicherung: New NAS, old backup: put it in the backup folder and have the emergency sheet ready. Afterwards you sign in with your previous credentials.
assistent.damit-niemand-sonst-im: So that nobody else in the network sets up your Ablago, it first asks for a code. Ablago stored it in two places at start-up:
assistent.in-der-docker-oberflaeche: {b} Open the project’s container {span} in your NAS’s Docker interface (on UGREEN: {i}, on Synology: {i2}) or on the command line {span2}. You’re looking for the line {span3}.
assistent.namens-im-ordner-fuer: {b} called {span} in the folder for the key, in the template {span2}.
assistent.wie-komme-ich-an: How do I get a DMS? ↗
assistent.wo-das-bei-deinem: Where that is on your device is shown, with pictures, in the guide for your platform: {link}
assistent.nach-der-einrichtung-ist: After setup the code is worthless; Ablago deletes the file.
assistent.name-des-datenbank-containers: Name of the database container, usually “db”
assistent.leer-lassen-bisheriges-behalte: leave empty = keep the previous one
assistent.darin-gibt-es-schon_one: – there is already a DMS in it ({anzahl} user).
assistent.darin-gibt-es-schon_other: – there is already a DMS in it ({anzahl} users).
assistent.die-datenbank-ist-leer: – the database is empty; Ablago creates its tables itself.
assistent.ablago-speichert-alles-ausser: Ablago stores everything except the files in PostgreSQL. In the Compose template the database runs as its own container “db”; the password is in the .env file next to it.
assistent.mit-database-url-aus: With DATABASE_URL from the Compose file
assistent.korrigiere-die-angaben-hier: Correct the details here – they are stored in /data/geheim and apply from then on, even if DATABASE_URL says otherwise.
assistent.dieser-benutzer-darf-keine: This user may not create databases. Create it in PostgreSQL or use the user from the Compose template.
sprache.unter: In which language would you like to set up Ablago? It then applies to everyone who doesn’t choose another one.
sprache.spaeter: You allow more languages later in the Workbench under Languages. Each person chooses their language in My account.
lauf.nutzung: Save how the Library is used
nutzung.titel: What will you use Ablago for?
nutzung.unter: So that Ablago suggests suitable packages and knows what to show.
nutzung.spaeter: You can change this later in the Workbench.
nutzung.privat.text: Contracts, insurance, invoices and certificates of the household.
nutzung.beruflich: For my work or my business
nutzung.beruflich.text: As a freelancer, in a club or in a business.
nutzung.beides.text: Home and work in one library.
nutzung.vorlage: The Workbench starts with the “{vorlage}” template.
nutzung.organisation.text: So that Ablago knows who “we” are – for example for GDPR access requests, and so that post from yourself is not recognised as a sender. Left empty, Ablago creates none; you can do that later in the library.
nutzung.organisation.name: Name
nutzung.organisation.name.hinweis: For example “Katrin Example Graphic Design” or “Brandt Joinery”.
nutzung.organisation.basis: This needs the Basis package – it is preselected in the next step.
pakete.basis: For your organisation “{name}” Ablago needs the Basis package – it is preselected, please keep it.
plan.organisation.name: Please enter the name of your organisation – or leave all fields empty.
plan.organisation.privat: An own organisation only exists for work use.
plan.organisation.basis: Your organisation needs the Basis package. Please select it, or clear the organisation in the “Use” step.
lauf.organisation.ohne-basis: “{name}” was not created: the Organisation folder type from the Basis package (1.7.0 or later) is missing. Create it later in the library and tick “Own organisation” there.
datei.kommentar.nutzung: What Ablago is used for: privat (home), beruflich (work) or beides (both).
datei.kommentar.organisation: Your organisation (only for work and both): created with the Basis package.
datei.fehler.beruflich: Does not match “nutzung: {nutzung}” – the entry can be left out.
datei.fehler.organisation: An own organisation only exists with “nutzung: beruflich” or “beides”.
abschluss.passkey.text: From now on, sign in with your fingerprint, face or your device's PIN – without a password and protected against fake sites. Your password stays as a fallback.
abschluss.passkey.spaeter.text: You can add one at any time under My account → Security.
